snippet.title: Night Machine - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The moon has split open, exposing an alien megafactory within. Your mission: Pilot a ramshackle ship to its core and shut it down. Just one catch... it can only be controlled with cards. Build synergies, adapt in real-time, and save Earth from the Night Machine before it's too late.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2974540/Night_Machine/

Discord: https://discord.gg/tYsNzCzqQs
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@nightmachinegame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nightmachinegame

Developed by Cooler Game Studios.
